name: Aminata Diallo
action: She politely declines Fatoumata's invitation and continues packing her tools to go home.
reason: Aminata is exhausted, has a textbook chapter waiting, and usually declines after-work outings because she protects her study time and avoids optional spending. The shared meal would cost money she would rather keep, and her memories link social gatherings with unplanned expenses, so she will likely refuse and leave for home.
